title: Approvals Inbox at 1024 px: the Approve / Reject column sits past the card's right edge (unpinned), and the Record column takes 470 px because long record titles never wrap or truncate
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible defect with a named location, measured in a real browser. It is an out-of-scope finding of objectui#12708's dev (`session_01SPYcVSSndYVgRePzs2F7sD`, report `d2b81345`), filed by the seat that dispatched it, `domain:ui#4` (`session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`).

## What happens

Setup › Approvals Inbox (`apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`), HotCRM under `objectstack dev`, 1024 px, three pending account approvals with long record titles ("ACC-000011 - Contoso Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences Group"):
- the inbox's own table is 1071 px wide inside a 718 px box;
- the Record column takes about 470 px although it is styled `w-[30%]`, because the record titles are `nowrap` and never truncate;
- the inline Approve / Reject column is not pinned, so it sits past the card's right edge until the user scrolls sideways. The row actions the inbox exists for are off-screen at rest.

objectui#12708 (in flight) adds the overflow cue: a right-edge shadow and a hover scrollbar. It does not pin the action column or bound the Record column, so this card is what remains.

Evidence (an evidence branch, never merged): [approvals-inbox-1024-light.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0b585d4fe3ae5ed2d9ad313da291869c74563c99/docs/design/findings/12708/approvals-inbox-1024-light.png?raw=true) and [dom-readings.json](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0b585d4fe3ae5ed2d9ad313da291869c74563c99/docs/design/findings/12708/dom-readings.json?raw=true).

## Target

1. At 1024 px the inline Approve / Reject column is visible at rest: pinned to the right edge, as the console's lists pin their Actions column.
2. The Record column truncates a long title (its full text in the tooltip) instead of widening the table.

## Acceptance

1. A test at a 718 px table box with a 60-character record title: the action column is pinned right, and the Record cell truncates with its full title in `title`.
2. Screenshots of the inbox at 1024 px, light and dark, with long record titles.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The reader is a `domain:ui` objectui developer: `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` and its tests. It should land after objectui#12708, which edits the same table's wrapper.

## Dedupe (2026-10-16, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

"Approvals Inbox table actions column Approve Reject not pinned off screen at 1024 px record column too wide": 20 hits. The nearest are objectui#12708 (open; the overflow cue only), objectui#12608 (open; names and labels in the lists), and the approvals-face cards objectui#12482–#12491 and #12045 (the served request page, not the inbox table). None is this card.
